note: A paper record of two MSNR readings. On eleven markets: the owner's earlier scalp method (direction call + M15 / M5 engulf): the direction call (H4, with Daily key levels) in front of an M15 then M5 engulf entry, entries with the call only; it is not an entry of the plan documents, and the desk's own study of it failed after costs. On gold: the plan with a fresh Daily level rejected (V, A or open-close level) and an H4 break within three trading days for the side, H4 zones, a 15- or 30-minute engulf entry or a 15- or 30-minute QM entry at its left shoulder, one entry a visit to a zone, a 30-pip stop and the target the owner picked on the 2026 records (60 pips on the engulf entry, 90 on the QM entry; the plan's own figure is 90). Nothing is traded and results are before costs.
